programs.name: Efficiency Manitoba: ducted cold climate heat pump
programs.rules: Existing primary home. Registered contractor. Contractor applies within 90 days of installation.

programs.name: Efficiency Manitoba: ductless cold climate heat pump
programs.rules: Existing primary home. Registered contractor. Contractor applies within 90 days of installation.

programs.name: Efficiency Manitoba: windows and doors
programs.rules: ENERGY STAR with at least triple pane glass. NRCan reference number needed. Apply within 90 days.

programs.name: Efficiency Manitoba: smart thermostat
programs.rules: ENERGY STAR certified. Install and apply within 90 days. Peak Partners can add up to $100 more in the first year for an eligible ecobee.

programs.name: Efficiency Manitoba: insulation

amount.label: $0.03 to $0.15 per sq ft per R added

programs.rules: Approval before any work. Attic, walls and foundation. Air sealing bonus up to $1,000. Shown but not added to your total.

programs.name: Energy Efficiency Assistance Program (income-based)
programs.rules: Single-detached or semi-detached home, lived in year-round, household income at or under the limit for your household size.

programs.name: National Heat Pump Rebate (federal, not open yet)
programs.rules: Announced October 8, 2026 and expected to launch in early 2027. The income line, eligible homes and how it combines with provincial programs are not published, so this is shown but not added to your total.

notes: Efficiency Manitoba's ground source heat pump program is financing, not a rebate, so it is not added to your total.
Amounts are the most a program pays. Your rebate depends on your quote and final invoice.
